senses.gloss: फल- + अदन फल- + अदन, m. a parrot.
फल- + आहार फल- + आहार, adj., f. री, in order to fetch fruits, Sāv. 4, 23.
फाल- + कृष्ट फाल- + कृष्ट, n. 1. tilled ground, Man. 4, 46. 2. produced by cultivation, 6, 16.
फल- + पूर फल- + पूर, m. common citron.
फल- + पूरक फल- + पूरक, m. a citron.

फल् फल् (sprung from original स्पर्, cf. स्फर्, स्फुर्), i. 1, Par.
 1. To burst, MBh. 3, 1654.
 2. To disappear (as if by bursting), MBh. 13, 7472.
 3. To produce, Hit. ii. d. 132.
 4. To bear fruit, figuratively, Man. 1, 84; to fall to one's share, Hit. 54, 18; to befall, Hit. iii. d. 21 (साधुषु, the good ones).
 5. To be fruitful, Bhartṛ. 2, 38.
 6. To be useful, 2, 98.
 7. Impersonal pass. फलितम् (supply अस्ति), Fruit is borne, produced, Hit. 21, 13.
 8. † To go.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. फलित (or फल + इत),
 1. Fruitful, bearing fruit, Hit. 47, 3, M.M.
 2. Successful, Daśak. in Chr. 196, 1.
 II. फुल्ल (instead of फल् + न),
 1. Blown, expanded as a flower, Ṛt. 6, 6; Pañc. i. d. 152.
 2. Opened (as the eyes, with [] pleasure), smiling.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, उत्फुल्ल,
 1. Blown, as a flower, Kir. 5, 39.
 2. Expanded (as the eyes, with fear), Rām. 3, 50, 15; (with surprise, with joy), Hit. 51, 10, M.M.; Indr. 2, 26.
 --Caus. फालय, To open, MBh. 1, 5977.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, प्रोत्फुल्ल, Blown, as a flower, Ṛt. 6, 34.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रफुल्ल,
 1. Blown, as a flower, Ṛt. 6, 1.
 2. Smiling.
 3. Shining.
 4. Glad.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To bound against, to be reflected, Śiś. 9, 37. प्रतिफलित,
 1. Reflected.
 2. Requited.
 --Cf. probably ὄϕελος, ὀϕέλλω; Lat. flos; A.S. blowan; Goth. bloma; A.S. bloma, blostma.

फल फल् + अ, n.
 1. Fruit, Utt. Rāmac. 33, 8.
 2. Revenue, Hit. iv. d. 121.
 3. Consequence, Chr. 9, 43.
 4. Result, Hit. iv. d. 98 (संख्या-मात्रम्, consisting only in the number, i. e. by reckoning four you have nothing but the number, really there is only one).
 5. Fulfilment of an omen, Śāk. d. 15.
 6. Gain, Bhartṛ. 2, 18.
 7. Reward.
 8. A shield.
 9. The blade of a sword or knife, the head of an arrow, Daśak. 197, 2(?).
 10. A ploughshare.
 --Comp.

फाल फाल, i. e. फल् + अ,
 I. m. n. The share of a plough, Man. 4, 46; 6, 16.
 II. m. A name of Śiva and Balarāma.

फलक फल + क,
 I. (m. and) n.
 1. A board, Man. 8, 396.
 2. A bench, Man. 2, 204 (Kull.).
 3. A layer, a base, Megh. 77 (at the end of a comp. adj., f. का, Having a base of crystal).
 4. Surface, Bhartṛ. 2, 28.
 5. A shield.
 6. A leaf for writing on, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 13 (? a small table).
 7. The bone of the forehead.
 II. n.
 1. The buttocks.
 2. The receptacle of the seed = core; in गण्ड-, a core-like, or core-representing cheek, Śiś. 9, 47 (at the end of a comp. adj. Having cheeks instead of cores).
 --Comp.

फलपाकान्त फलपाकान्त, i. e. फल-पाक + अन्त,
 I. adj., f. ता, Perishing when the fruit is mature, Man. 1, 46.
 II. f. ता, An annual plant.
फलमुद्गरिका फलमुद्गरिका, i. e. फल-मुद्गर + क, f. A sort of date.
फलवन्त् फल + वन्त्, adj. वति, [] Bearing fruit, Man. 1, 47; fruitful, Hit. pr. 43, M.M.
फलस फल-स, m. The jack or bread-fruit-tree

फलिन् फलिन्, i. e. फल + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी, Having fruits, Cāṇ. 21 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 408; bearing fruit, Man. 1, 47.
 II. m. A tree, MBh. 14, 498.
 III. f. नी.
 1. = Priyaṅgu.
 2. A potherb, Echites dichotoma.
 3. A flower, Celosia cristata.
फलिन फलिन् + अ, adj. Bearing fruit.

फल्क फल्क, adj., explained by विशोधिताङ्क, which may be विशोधित-अङ्क, or शोधित-अङ्क with वि.
 --Cf. perhaps ϕολκός.

फल्गु फल्गु, i. e. स्फुर्ज् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Pithless, sapless.
 2. Vain, worthless, Pañc. pr. d. 10.
 3. Weak, Hit. iii. d. 79.
 II. f.
 1. The opposite-leaved fig-tree.
 2. The spring season.
 3. Falsehood.

फल्गुता फल्गु + ता, f., and फल्गुत्व फल्गु + त्व, n. Vainness, Bhartṛ. 2, 9.
 --Cf. सारफल्गुत्व.

फल्गुन फल्गु + न,
 I. m.
 1. The month Phālguna.
 2. A name of Arjuna.
 II. f. नी, du. or pl. The eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distinguished as former, पूर्व, and latter, उत्तर; see फाल्गुन.

फाल्गुन फाल्गुन, i. e. फल्गुन + अ,
 I. m.
 1. A month, February--March, Rājat. 5, 221.
 2. A name of Arjuna, Johns. Sel. 13, 43.
 3. A sort of tree, Pentaptera arjuna.
 II. f. नी.
 1. The day of full moon in the month Phālguna.
 2. The name of the eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distinguished by the epithet former, पूर्व, and latter, उत्तर.

फल्गुनक फल्गुन + क, m.
 1. Name of a people, Mārk. P. 58, 36.
 2. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 472.
फल्य फल्य, i. e. फल + य, n. A flower.
फल- + संस्थ फल- + संस्थ, adj. bearing fruit, Brāhmaṇav. 3, 13.
फल- + हीन फल- + हीन, adj. yielding no profit, Pañc. i. d. 168.
